required_own_edits.source_excerpt: Fix a finite regular diagram $D$ of a nonempty oriented link $L\subset S^3$, choose a basepoint $p\in D$ away from the crossings, and choose an admissible pointed Heegaard multi-diagram subordinate to the branched-cover surgeries, with the compatible perturbation data and top-generator cycles of the link-surgery construction. Identify each first-page vertex group with the reduced state space of the corresponding crossingless resolution, based at the circle containing $p$. For every cube edge, the induced first differential is the mod-two map assigned by the saddle: multiplication when two resolution circles merge and comultiplication when one resolution circle splits, with the marked-circle quotient at $p$. Under these identifications the direct sum of edge maps is the reduced Khovanov differential of the mirror diagram $\overline D$, based at the corresponding point, in the Ozsváth–Szabó smoothing convention.
